statusDetail: Audit stopped during recon. Cloudflare managed challenge intercepted the entry URL and required an interactive human verification; the origin content, routes, forms, and representative journeys were not reachable from the raw-CDP audit session.

page.notes: The origin application could not be profiled. All observable markup belongs to a Cloudflare managed challenge.
